beats.hook: My ex showed up at my new apartment — six months after I'd blocked him on everything — holding a key.
beats.the_wrong: I never gave him that key. I found out later he'd followed me on move-in day. He watched from the parking lot and copied down the address.
beats.the_plan: I didn't call the police right away. I had a better idea — and it involved his mother, Carol.
beats.the_execution: I called Carol and told her calmly — very calmly — exactly what her son had done. The silence on her end lasted a full four seconds. Then I forwarded her the screenshots. Every "I know where you live now" text he'd sent from a number he thought I didn't recognize. Carol showed up to his place before the cops did.
beats.the_satisfaction: He called me that night — not to threaten me — to apologize. Turns out Carol had packed his things into garbage bags and left them on the front porch. I finally felt like I could breathe. Have you ever had someone in your life who thought obsession was the same thing as love?
beats.cta: Drop a one or a two in the comments — one if you've been there, two if you want to hear what Carol said to him. Because apparently it was legendary.
